line: [CR4] no link heading: "I do not rest D5 on Luke 3 being Mary's line, because the text does not say so."

[CR4] C4: "- I concede ʿalmāh does not itself state virginity, since that rests at bethûlāh (virgin) in 24:16. I do not rest on it, so D4's limb stays narrowed."

[CR4] C4: "Mary's own descent from David is not given in the KJV, since Luke 1:27 attaches ‘of the house of David’ to the nearer name and Luke 2:4 attaches it to Joseph. I do not rest D6's denial on it."
[CR4] C4: "These are cited by the challenger as seed said of women, and I do not rest on them."
